gloss: edible; for eating; for food use

definitions.gloss: edible; for eating; for food use
definitions.explanation: edible; for eating; for food use

examples.japanese: この{花|はな}は{食用|しょくよう}です。
{食用|しょくよう}キノコと{毒|どく}キノコを{見分|みわ}けるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It is difficult to distinguish edible mushrooms from poisonous ones.

examples.japanese: この{油|あぶら}は{食用|しょくよう}ではなく{工業用|こうぎょうよう}なので、{口|くち}に{入|い}れないでください。
examples.english: This oil is for industrial use, not food use, so please do not put it in your mouth.

notes:
Indicates that something is suitable or intended for consumption as food. Composed of {食|しょく} (eat, food) and {用|よう} (use, purpose). Often used to distinguish edible items from non-edible or decorative versions of the same thing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食用|しょくよう}{油|あぶら}/{油|ゆ}: cooking oil
- {食用|しょくよう}キノコ: edible mushroom
- {食用|しょくよう}{花|ばな}: edible flower
- {食用|しょくよう}{色素|しきそ}: food coloring
- {食用|しょくよう}に{適|てき}する: suitable for consumption

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲食用|いんしょくよう}: for food and drink — includes beverages
- {観賞用|かんしょうよう}: for viewing/decorative use — contrasts with {食用|しょくよう}
- {薬用|やくよう}: for medicinal use — another common -{用|よう} compound
